43.steps:
1. Load a firmware and boot with factory default settings.
  2. Configure interfaces.
  3. On the Users>Setting page, select LDAP from the Authentication Methods drop-down list and click the Configure button.
  4. Select either OK (re-direct to HTTPS) or Cancel (continue using HTTP) in the following message.
  5. In the Settings tab, enter the FQDN of the PC connected to X0 (LDAP server), login user name and password. Have the Require valid certificate from server check box turned on. Have LDAP version 3 selected in the Protocol version field.
  6. In the Directory tab, specify a primary domain.
  7. In the LDAP Users tab, select 'Trusted Users' as a default LDAP user group.
  8. On the Firewall > Access Rules page go to LAN>WAN and set the User Allowed field to Trusted Users in the rule. Add a new rule to allow DNS service.
  9. Logout from the management screen and attempt to access the Internet. When a browser gets re-directed to /auth.html page, login as qatest entering a valid password.
43.initial:
LDAP Server --- X0 SonicWALL
  Windows Certificate Services must be installed on the LDAP server. Download the CA certificate and save locally. Import the CA certificate .cer file on the SonicWALL.
  On the Active Directory, create a group 'group1'. Create a user 'qatest' and add it to the 'group1'.
43.title: Functional. LDAP version 3 is used
43.result: Qatest is logged in. The User Login Status window is displayed.
